newsitem.title: USA: AMC Entertainment chairman begins cancer treatment.
newsitem.headline: AMC Entertainment chairman begins cancer treatment.

text.p: AMC Entertainment Inc said Friday Stanley Durwood, its chairman and chief executive officer, has begun treatment for recently diagnosed esophageal cancer.
Durwood is expected to continue in both posts while undergoing treatment and will remain active in the management of the company, AMC Entertainment said.

The company also expanded the duties of two of its executives, electing Chief Financial Officer Peter Brown president of AMC Entertainment and Philip Singleton president of its theatrical distribution operation. Both executives will continue to report to Durwood.
AMC Entertainment is a holding company that operates 1,932 screens in 231 movie theaters in 23 states.
Its shares closed up 1/8 Friday at 16-1/8.
